meta.titleEn: Ibuprofen 200 mg Tablets (Fever Reducer and Anti-inflammatory Pain Reliever)
meta.actionKo: 비스테로이드성 소염진통제로 발열과 관절염·요통·두통·치통 등 다양한 통증을 완화합니다.
meta.actionEn: A nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug that relieves fever and a wide range of pain including arthritis, back pain, headache, and toothache.

en.70cda5ec: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease), fever and pain from colds, back pain, dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), pain after surgery and ankylosing spondylitis, headache, toothache, muscle pain, nerve pain, acute gout, psoriatic arthritis, soft tissue injury (sprains, bruises), and non-articular rheumatic diseases (tendinitis, tenosynovitis, bursitis).
en.bbd09d7a: This medicine is used for fever and pain from colds, back pain, menstrual pain, rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease), pain after surgery and headache, toothache, muscle pain, nerve pain, ankylosing spondylitis, acute gout, psoriatic arthritis, soft tissue injury (sprains, bruises), and non-articular rheumatic diseases (tendinitis, tenosynovitis, bursitis).
en.755b969b: For rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, soft tissue injury, non-articular rheumatic diseases, acute gout, and psoriatic arthritis, adults may be given 1 to 3 tablets (200 to 600 mg) per dose, 3 to 4 times a day, up to a maximum of 16 tablets (3,200 mg) per 1 day; for juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, give 30 to 40 mg per kg of body weight per 1 day by mouth divided into 3 to 4 doses; for mild and moderate pain or colds, adults take 1 to 2 tablets (200 to 400 mg) per dose, 3 to 4 times a day.
en.7c150e4f: For rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, soft tissue injury, non-articular rheumatic diseases, acute gout, and psoriatic arthritis, adults may take 1 to 3 tablets (200 to 600 mg) per dose, 3 to 4 times a day, up to a maximum of 16 tablets (3,200 mg) per 1 day; for juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, take 30 to 40 mg per kg of body weight per 1 day divided into 3 to 4 doses; for mild and moderate pain or colds, adults take 1 to 2 tablets (200 to 400 mg) per dose, 3 to 4 times a day.
en.10261fae: Children 11 to 14 years old take 200 to 250 mg per dose; 7 to 10 years old, 150 to 200 mg per dose; 3 to 6 years old, 100 to 150 mg per dose; and 1 to 2 years old, 50 to 100 mg per dose, 3 to 4 times a day.
en.94b555ae: For children weighing less than 30 kg, the amount per 1 day must not exceed 500 mg, and it is advisable to avoid taking this medicine on an empty stomach.
en.8aa3dfc9: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it; have or have had gastrointestinal ulcers or gastrointestinal bleeding; have severe blood abnormalities, severe liver disorders, severe kidney disorders, severe heart failure, or severe high blood pressure; have or have had bronchial asthma; have or have had hypersensitivity such as asthma, hives, or allergic reactions to aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (including COX-2 inhibitors); have pain before or after coronary artery bypass graft surgery; are in the last 3 months of pregnancy or are breastfeeding; or are receiving high-dose methotrexate as anticancer therapy.
en.fdc9c180: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it; have gastrointestinal ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver disorders, severe kidney disorders, severe heart failure, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma; have experienced asthma, hives, or allergic reactions caused by aspirin or other anti-inflammatory pain relievers; have pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass graft surgery; are in the last 3 months of pregnancy or are breastfeeding; are receiving high-dose methotrexate as anticancer therapy; or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
en.76f62dba: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have blood abnormalities or a tendency to bleed, liver cirrhosis, liver disorders, kidney disorders, heart failure, heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus, mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease, are an older adult, are a child under 2 years of age, are pregnant or breastfeeding, take low-dose aspirin, or have chickenpox.
en.b3bf9456: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have or have had blood abnormalities, have a tendency to bleed, have or have had liver cirrhosis or liver disorders, have or have had kidney disorders, have heart failure or heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus or mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease, are an older adult or child, or are pregnant.
en.7fdf65fc: Do not take this medicine together with other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) or high-dose methotrexate.
en.2ee9d3ca: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using this medicine together with low-dose aspirin, low-dose methotrexate, ACE inhibitors, lithium, furosemide and thiazide diuretics, coumarin anticoagulants (such as warfarin), or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
en.6544c374: If the following occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist: shock symptoms (heartburn, chills, difficulty breathing, lowered blood pressure, etc.); blood disorders such as decreased hematocrit, decreased hemoglobin, anemia, aplastic anemia, hemolytic anemia, agranulocytosis, granulocytopenia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, reduced platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), or eosinophilia;
